name: 大嗓门
description: 场上固定出现一个大嗓门；他存在时，每次抽取后空出的格子会自动填入一个抢菜人；抽到大嗓门将其移除，抢菜人停止刷新；抽到抢菜人将随机夺走你篮中的一件食材
description_en: A Loudmouth appears on the board; while present, each emptied cell refills with a Competitor; draw the Loudmouth to remove it; drawing a Competitor steals a random item from your basket
